messages:
alex: Found a tiny fake cactus in the kitchen labeled "property of unknown". i propose we adopt it as the official office charging totem. name ideas?
priya: calling it Quincy immediately. Quincy the Charging Cactus.
tom: Quincy is cursed to watch chargers get lost forever.
emily: i'm on team Quincy. also ritual: anyone who borrows a charger must leave a snack. fair? :cookie:
noah: small fee accepted in gummy bears.
priya: governance proposal: custody rotates weekly. custodian is responsible for keeping a spare USB-C cable attached and posting a custodial selfie when shift changes.
alex: love the selfie requirement. makes it official.
emily: poll: :thumbsup: Quincy, :heart: Charging Platypus, :laughing: Cable Kraken. react with your vote.
office-bot: Reminder: Kitchen supplies low. Coffee pods at 2 left.
tom: urgent: someone took the green cable last week. it haunts me.
noah: i solemnly swear to return the green cable. if i fail, i will provide donuts.
priya: added rule: no taking other people's labeled chargers. label your stuff with initials.
alex: i'll make a tiny laminated tag for Quincy that says "Quincy: Office Totem". who's painting it?
emily: volunteer: i've got paint pens. will bring on Friday.
priya: ceremonial first charge: Friday 3pm. bring snacks and a jaunty hat for Quincy.
tom: will there be a tiny throne?
alex: yes. planning a shoebox throne with confetti.
noah: //posts blurry phone pic of Quincy wearing a paper party hat//
priya: official name accepted. Quincy is now on probationary sacred status.
office-bot: :sparkles: Office Totem "Quincy" added to Lore book (channel: #random).
emily: custody rota week1: @alex, week2: @priya, week3: @tom. i'll update the whiteboard.
alex: proud to be Quincy custodian. will keep chargers safe and snacks plentiful. :cactus:
priya: may Quincy protect our devices from low-battery doom.
tom: long live Quincy.
noah: will compose Quincy anthem for Friday unveiling. warning: it will be terrible. :grimacing:
